integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for 1111.4641 lists the first submission on 2011-11-20.
integrity.formula_basis: Proposition 4.1 of the archival source gives the higher-dual degree formula for rational normal scrolls in the stated range.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The archival source is classified under MSC 14M25 and 14T05.

scientific_limitations: Smooth complex rational normal scrolls with dimension at least two and smallest twist at least two.
Only the initial higher-dual range through the smallest twist is covered.
The theorem concerns the gcd of the complete degree tower in that range, not arbitrary subcollections.
An unindexed older source could contain the short arithmetic consequence of the published degree formula.
title: Common divisors in the higher-dual tower of rational normal scrolls
